<div class="report-builder">

::: {.callout-note}
## Build a report bundle

1. Upload the `glider_field_mapping.json` downloaded from **Data Intake**.
2. Select compatible functions, then use **Move up** and **Move down** to set their report order.
3. Choose a document format and review the live preview.
4. Download the ZIP and place it in `output/` before extracting and running it locally.
:::

## 1. Load mapped fields

```{ojs}
viewof report_builder_mapping_file = Inputs.file({
  label: "Import Field Mapping",
  accept: ".json,application/json"
})
```

```{ojs}
report_builder_mapping_state = {
  if (!report_builder_mapping_file) {
    return {
      mappings: {},
      error: null
    };
  }

  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(await report_builder_mapping_file.text());
    const mappings = parsed.mappings ?? parsed;
    if (!mappings || Array.isArray(mappings) || typeof mappings !== "object") {
      throw new Error("The mapping JSON must contain an object.");
    }

    const validMappings = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(mappings).filter(
        ([standardField, userField]) =>
          typeof standardField === "string"
          && typeof userField === "string"
          && standardField.trim()
          && userField.trim()
      )
    );
    return {mappings: validMappings, error: null};
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      mappings: {},
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
    };
  }
}

report_builder_mapping_text = JSON.stringify(
  report_builder_mapping_state.mappings,
  null,
  2
)

report_builder_mapped_fields = Object.keys(
  report_builder_mapping_state.mappings
)
```

```{ojs}
report_builder_mapping_status = {
  if (report_builder_mapping_state.error) {
    return html`<div class="report-builder__status report-builder__status--error">
      Mapping import failed: ${report_builder_mapping_state.error}
    </div>`;
  }

  if (report_builder_mapped_fields.length === 0) {
    return html`<div class="report-builder__status">
      Upload a field mapping to identify compatible functions.
    </div>`;
  }

  return html`<div class="report-builder__status report-builder__status--success">
    ${report_builder_mapped_fields.length} mapped field${report_builder_mapped_fields.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}:
    ${report_builder_mapped_fields.join(", ")}
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
report_builder_registry = JSON.parse(
  await FileAttachment("functions/registry.json").text()
)

report_builder_classified = report_builder_registry.map((entry) => {
  const requiredFields = entry.required_fields || [];
  const missing_fields = requiredFields.filter(
    (field) => !report_builder_mapped_fields.includes(field)
  );
  return {...entry, missing_fields};
})

report_builder_available = report_builder_classified.filter((entry) => {
  const requiredFields = entry.required_fields || [];
  return requiredFields.every(
    (field) => report_builder_mapped_fields.includes(field)
  );
})

report_builder_incompatible = report_builder_classified.filter(
  (entry) => entry.missing_fields.length > 0
)
```

## 2. Choose and order functions

### Available Functions

```{ojs}
viewof report_builder_selection = {
  const form = document.createElement("form");
  form.className = "report-builder__function-list";
  let orderedIds = report_builder_available.map((entry) => entry.id);
  const selectedIds = new Set();

  Object.defineProperty(form, "value", {
    get() {
      return orderedIds.filter((id) => selectedIds.has(id));
    }
  });

  const emit = () => {
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };

  const render = () => {
    form.replaceChildren();
    if (orderedIds.length === 0) {
      const empty = document.createElement("p");
      empty.className = "report-builder__empty";
      empty.textContent = report_builder_mapped_fields.length === 0
        ? "Upload a mapping to see compatible functions."
        : "No functions support all currently mapped fields.";
      form.append(empty);
      return;
    }

    orderedIds.forEach((id, index) => {
      const entry = report_builder_available.find((item) => item.id === id);
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "report-builder__function";

      const label = document.createElement("label");
      const checkbox = document.createElement("input");
      checkbox.type = "checkbox";
      checkbox.checked = selectedIds.has(id);
      checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => {
        if (checkbox.checked) selectedIds.add(id);
        else selectedIds.delete(id);
        emit();
      });

      const details = document.createElement("span");
      const name = document.createElement("strong");
      name.textContent = entry.name;
      const metadata = document.createElement("small");
      metadata.textContent = `${entry.language} · ${entry.output_type}`;
      details.append(name, metadata);
      label.append(checkbox, details);

      const controls = document.createElement("span");
      controls.className = "report-builder__order-controls";
      for (const [text, offset] of [["Move up", -1], ["Move down", 1]]) {
        const button = document.createElement("button");
        button.type = "button";
        button.textContent = text;
        button.disabled = index + offset < 0 || index + offset >= orderedIds.length;
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          report_builder_move(orderedIds, index, index + offset);
          render();
          emit();
        });
        controls.append(button);
      }

      row.append(label, controls);
      form.append(row);
    });
  };

  render();
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
report_builder_move = (items, fromIndex, toIndex) => {
  const [item] = items.splice(fromIndex, 1);
  items.splice(toIndex, 0, item);
  return items;
}
```

<details class="report-builder__incompatible">
<summary>Incompatible Functions ({ojs} report_builder_incompatible.length)</summary>

```{ojs}
report_builder_incompatible_list = {
  const list = document.createElement("div");
  list.className = "report-builder__incompatible-list";

  if (report_builder_incompatible.length === 0) {
    const message = document.createElement("p");
    message.textContent = report_builder_mapped_fields.length === 0
      ? "Upload a mapping to review missing fields."
      : "All registered functions are compatible.";
    list.append(message);
    return list;
  }

  for (const entry of report_builder_incompatible) {
    const card = document.createElement("article");
    const title = document.createElement("strong");
    const reason = document.createElement("p");
    title.textContent = entry.name;
    reason.textContent = `Missing fields: ${entry.missing_fields.join(", ")}`;
    card.append(title, reason);
    list.append(card);
  }
  return list;
}
```

</details>

## 3. Select a format and preview

```{ojs}
viewof report_builder_format = Inputs.select(
  new Map([
    ["Quarto (.qmd)", "qmd"],
    ["R Markdown (.Rmd)", "rmd"],
    ["Python (.py)", "py"]
  ]),
  {label: "Export target", value: "qmd"}
)
```

```{ojs}
report_builder_selected_entries = report_builder_selection
  .map((id) => report_builder_registry.find((entry) => entry.id === id))
  .filter(Boolean)

report_builder_fence = "\x60\x60\x60"

report_builder_module = (entry, format) => {
  const citation = entry.citation || "No citation supplied.";
  const heading = format === "py"
    ? `\n# ${entry.name}\n# Citation: ${citation}\n`
    : `\n## ${entry.name}\n\n**Citation:** ${citation}\n\n`;

  if (format === "py") {
    return entry.language === "Python"
      ? `${heading}runpy.run_path(${JSON.stringify(entry.code_file)}, run_name="__main__")\n`
      : `${heading}# This ${entry.language} module is included in the bundle at:\n# ${entry.code_file}\n`;
  }

  if (entry.language === "Python") {
    return `${heading}${report_builder_fence}{python}\nimport runpy\nrunpy.run_path(${JSON.stringify(entry.code_file)}, run_name="__main__")\n${report_builder_fence}\n`;
  }

  if (/\.r$/i.test(entry.code_file)) {
    return `${heading}${report_builder_fence}{r}\nsource(here::here(${entry.code_file.split("/").map(JSON.stringify).join(", ")}))\n${report_builder_fence}\n`;
  }

  const childPath = entry.code_file.split("/").map(JSON.stringify).join(", ");
  return `${heading}${report_builder_fence}{r, results='asis'}\ncat(knitr::knit_child(here::here(${childPath}), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\\n")\n${report_builder_fence}\n`;
}

report_builder_document = {
  const modules = report_builder_selected_entries
    .map((entry) => report_builder_module(entry, report_builder_format))
    .join("\n");

  if (report_builder_format === "py") {
    return `"""Custom Glider Report.

Generated by Glider Reporter. Update DATA_FILE before running.
"""

import json
import runpy
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from python.data_cleaner import clean_glider_data

DATA_FILE = Path("data/glider_data.csv")
with Path("glider_field_mapping.json").open(encoding="utf-8") as mapping_file:
    field_mapping = json.load(mapping_file)

report_data = pd.read_csv(DATA_FILE)
report_data = report_data.rename(
    columns={user_field: standard_field for standard_field, user_field in field_mapping.items()}
)
report_data = clean_glider_data(report_data)
${modules || "\n# Select at least one compatible function in the report builder.\n"}`;
  }

  const yaml = report_builder_format === "qmd"
    ? `---\ntitle: "Custom Glider Report"\nformat: html\n---`
    : `---\ntitle: "Custom Glider Report"\noutput: html_document\n---`;
  const setup = `${report_builder_fence}{r setup, include=FALSE}
field_mapping <- jsonlite::read_json(
  here::here("glider_field_mapping.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)
report_data <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("data", "glider_data.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
for (standard_field in names(field_mapping)) {
  user_field <- field_mapping[[standard_field]]
  names(report_data)[names(report_data) == user_field] <- standard_field
}
source(here::here("R", "data_cleaner.R"))
report_data <- clean_glider_data(report_data)
${report_builder_fence}`;

  return `${yaml}

${setup}

Update \`data/glider_data.csv\` with your local input data before rendering.
${modules || "\nSelect at least one compatible function in the report builder.\n"}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
report_builder_preview = {
  const pre = document.createElement("pre");
  const code = document.createElement("code");
  pre.className = "report-builder__preview";
  pre.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  code.textContent = report_builder_document;
  pre.append(code);
  return pre;
}
```

## 4. Download the report bundle

```{ojs}
report_builder_dependencies = Promise.all([
  require("jszip@3.10.1"),
  require("file-saver@2.0.5")
])

report_builder_fetch_text = async (path) => {
  const response = await fetch(new URL(path, document.baseURI));
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Unable to add ${path} (${response.status}).`);
  }
  return response.text();
}

report_builder_report_name = new Map([
  ["qmd", "custom_glider_report.qmd"],
  ["rmd", "custom_glider_report.Rmd"],
  ["py", "custom_glider_report.py"]
]).get(report_builder_format)

report_builder_readme = `CUSTOM GLIDER REPORT
====================

Bundle contents
---------------
- ${report_builder_report_name}: generated report
- functions/: selected reporting modules
- R/data_cleaner.R and python/data_cleaner.py: data-cleaning helpers
- glider_field_mapping.json: your reusable field mapping

Before running
--------------
1. Extract this ZIP inside the project's output/ directory.
2. Create a data/ folder and save your input as data/glider_data.csv.
3. Install the packages used by the generated report and selected modules.

RStudio
-------
Open ${report_builder_report_name}. For .qmd choose Render; for .Rmd choose Knit.

VS Code
-------
Open the extracted folder. Render .qmd with "quarto render ${report_builder_report_name}",
or run the Python file with "python ${report_builder_report_name}".

Jupyter
-------
For Python output, open a terminal in the extracted folder and run
"jupyter lab", then use "%run ${report_builder_report_name}" in a notebook.
`
```

```{ojs}
report_builder_download = {
  const button = document.createElement("button");
  button.type = "button";
  button.className = "report-builder__download";
  button.textContent = "Download Report Bundle";
  button.disabled = report_builder_selected_entries.length === 0
    || report_builder_mapping_state.error !== null;

  const status = document.createElement("span");
  status.className = "report-builder__download-status";
  status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");

  button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    button.disabled = true;
    status.textContent = "Building bundle…";
    try {
      const [JSZipModule, FileSaverModule] = await report_builder_dependencies;
      const JSZip = JSZipModule.default || JSZipModule;
      const saveAs = FileSaverModule.saveAs
        || FileSaverModule.default
        || FileSaverModule;
      const zip = new JSZip();
      const functionsFolder = zip.folder("functions");

      zip.file(report_builder_report_name, report_builder_document);
      zip.file("glider_field_mapping.json", report_builder_mapping_text);
      zip.file("README.txt", report_builder_readme);
      zip.file("R/data_cleaner.R", await report_builder_fetch_text("R/data_cleaner.R"));
      zip.file(
        "python/data_cleaner.py",
        await report_builder_fetch_text("python/data_cleaner.py")
      );

      for (const entry of report_builder_selected_entries) {
        if (!entry.code_file) continue;
        const relativePath = entry.code_file.replace(/^functions\//, "");
        functionsFolder.file(
          relativePath,
          await report_builder_fetch_text(entry.code_file)
        );
      }

      const bundle = await zip.generateAsync({type: "blob"});
      saveAs(bundle, "custom_glider_report_bundle.zip");
      status.textContent = "Download ready. Place the ZIP in output/.";
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = `Bundle failed: ${
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      }`;
    } finally {
      button.disabled = report_builder_selected_entries.length === 0;
    }
  });

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.className = "report-builder__download-row";
  container.append(button, status);
  return container;
}
```

All processing occurs in your browser. Place the downloaded ZIP in `output/`;
that directory is reserved for user-generated exports.

</div>
